issue_request: FHIR-15650 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for STU3 asking to fix ElementDefinition invariant eld-2 because the previous expression assumed short-circuit evaluation and could call max.toInteger() when max was '*'.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 13338. Imported git commit 13dfd25e58392c4b0a6851301f593a28b63a198f, '#15650 - fix eld-2 invariant', changed source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml from the unsafe expression to the guarded iif(max != '*', min <= max.toInteger()) expression.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active datatype and maps it to the eld prefix, confirming the inspected spreadsheet source is in current build scope. FHIR-15649 is mentioned from the seed Jira comments but concerns the separate Bundle bdl-7 invariant and was applied separately, so it was not decided here. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source at source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml:4622 already matches the requested corrected eld-2 FHIRPath expression, and active-source searches did not find the old unsafe eld-2 expression.
